platform_capabilities.name: Bug Report Tool
platform_capabilities.request: multipart/form-data: email, module, description (50 to 10000 characters), app_version, current_tab; optional files screenshot (repeatable), telemetry, recording
platform_capabilities.delivery: Saves a Bug Report Archive (ZIP) under bug-reports/ in the workspace root and opens the user's own mail client with a mailto: link; the user attaches the ZIP by hand. No SMTP credentials ship with the application.

components.screenshot_annotator: GUI ScreenshotAnnotator: captures the app window and lets the user draw one highlight rectangle before the image is attached.
components.telemetry_csv: GUI telemetryCsv: RFC 4180 CSV with the columns timestamp, status, source, message, built from pipeline events.
components.screen_recording: implemented (GUI v2.10.20): native app-window-only recorder (Windows Graphics Capture, Windows only), H.264 MP4 up to 60 s, 854x480 at 24 fps, attached as recording.mp4; other platforms report that recording is not supported yet.

platform_capabilities.name: Sidecar Security Contract (Origin Guard)

client_header.name: X-LemGendary-Client
client_header.required_for: browser requests (with an Origin header) that use POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE

platform_capabilities.rejection: HTTP 403 with a JSON detail; WebSocket handshakes from other origins are refused
platform_capabilities.non_browser_clients: Requests without an Origin header (CLI, scripts, tests) are allowed
platform_capabilities.secrets_api: GET /api/secrets returns only whether each secret is set and its last 4 characters; POST /api/secrets sets or replaces a value (Environment Manager, port 8000)

platform_capabilities.name: Pareto Model Soup
limitations: Blends vault checkpoints; a run with Stochastic Weight Averaging enabled adds vault_swa.pth as an ingredient.
The blend is not evaluated automatically and BatchNorm statistics are not re-estimated after blending.

platform_capabilities.name: Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA)
limitations: Mini-SWA and Metric-Specific SWA (MS-SWA) are not implemented.
SWA metrics never reach the SOTA tracker or the governor; curriculum rungs are unchanged.

cli.command: lemtrain train MODEL_KEY (with swa.enabled: true in config.yaml)

platform_capabilities.name: FID Re-evaluation Tool
platform_capabilities.metric: FID with feature=2048, chunks of at most 2 samples, strict checkpoint loading

exit_codes.3: FID invariant failure or missing backend

platform_capabilities.name: Shard-Window Sampling and Block-Wise Curriculum Fractions
behaviour: window_shards > 0: the train sampler shuffles the shards per epoch and the samples inside windows of that many shards; the order is drawn from seed + epoch, splits across DDP ranks and resumes mid-epoch.
fraction_block_size > 0: a curriculum data fraction is built from shuffled contiguous blocks inside each shard; the subsets stay nested across fraction steps (Monotonic Ratchet).
limitations: Off by default; the GPU throughput gain on real manifolds is not measured yet.
Applies to WebDataset shards; other samples share one window key per dataset.
